text.p: Copa America hosts Bolivia were still struggling to come to terms with public apathy on Saturday.
"All we can do is give more of ourselves and play better, which we are capable of doing," said midfielder Erwin Sanchez, who came on at halftime in Thursday's 1-0 win over Venezuela.
Bolivian Football Federation official Mario Arce appealed for more support after only 10,000 watched Thursday's game in the 45,000-capacity Hernando Silas stadium.
The poor turnout came at the same time as the local media launched a national team boycott in response to a move by the players to refuse interviews.
The players were angry at criticism of their performance last Sunday.when they drew 1-1 away to Venezuela in a World Cup qualifier.
In spite of the lack of support, Bolivia are among the favourites to win the competition, mainly because they have the advantage of playing their games in the capital at 3,600 metres above sea level.
